title: ADD FOREIGN KEY with ALGORITHM=INPLACE while foreign_key_checks is enabled
violated_rule: ADD FOREIGN KEY supports INPLACE only when foreign_key_checks is disabled
expected_feedback: CRITICAL: the manual states 'The INPLACE algorithm is supported when foreign_key_checks is disabled. Otherwise, only the COPY algorithm is supported.' With checks enabled (the default) this statement fails. There is no online-and-validated path for ADD FOREIGN KEY: either accept COPY — a full rebuild with writes blocked, unacceptable at 12M rows — or verify orphans yourself, set foreign_key_checks=0, take the INPLACE path, and accept a constraint the server never validated. State which one you chose. For a table this size the practical answer is the verified-then-INPLACE path, or pt-osc if other tables reference order_items.
